office_does: The sheriff leads county law enforcement in Whitman County, including patrol and investigations, the county jail, civil process and court security, and the regional drug task force.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Sheriff Brett Myers, in office since 2003, is seeking a seventh term with no opponent.

candidates.summary: Whitman County Sheriff since 2003 after serving as a deputy and sergeant in the office from 1996. Unopposed in 2022 and again on this ballot; submitted no pamphlet statement.
highlights: Sheriff since January 2003; seeking a seventh four-year term [S4]
Deputy from 1996 and sergeant from 2000 before becoming sheriff [S5]
Unopposed in 2022, with 10,564 votes to 487 write-ins [S7]
